variants.prompt: On a moonlit, stone balcony overlooking the Vltava River, Ophelia perches on the edge, her long, slender legs extended in front of her, her feet bare and crossed at the ankles. She wears a diaphanous, pale blue robe that falls open, revealing the creamy expanse of her back and the tantalizing curves of her breasts, barely contained by a lacy bra. Her raven hair is loose and flowing, and she looks down at the glittering river below with an enigmatic, half-lidded gaze, her full, parted lips inviting the viewer to share her secret world.
